name: Celestial Oud
description:
The Vibe: An ethereal balance of mystery and elegance.

The Scent Journey: A beautifully balanced opening of fresh aromatic greens and luminous white florals, energized by warm spices. The fragrance evolves into a luxurious heart of velvety musk and soft powdery accords, before resting on a rich foundation of premium leather, precious woods, and golden amber.

Best For: Making an unforgettable, graceful, and deeply captivating impression.
